lower_description: flat solid bright green chroma-key color, one uniform green, no texture, no shading, no dithering
upper_description: raised rectangular panel plate for a 16-bit strategy game menu: faded blue nautical-chart paper face, pale sky-blue with sparse subtle fiber grain and faint weathered blotches, framed by a carved warm brown wood rim with a 1px dark outline just inside it, light from top-left: the top-left bevel slope lit warm, the bottom-right slope in deep shadow, retro 16-bit UI in the style of classic 1990s naval adventure games like Uncharted Waters 2 / New Horizons, crisp deliberate pixels, flat color fills, no text, no icons
transition_description: low raised wood rim ending in a crisp straight edge with square corners and a 1px dark outline at the plate silhouette, Uncharted Waters 2 beveled chart-panel edge
